[ASSISTANT_SAID] Explained the difference between weighted hammer action and graded hammer action in digital pianos.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Described weighted hammer action as having evenly weighted keys suitable for beginners.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Described graded hammer action as having varying weight across keys, providing a more expressive playing experience.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in the difference between digital pianos and keyboards.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Explained that digital pianos mimic acoustic pianos with weighted keys, while keyboards are more general-purpose instruments with non-weighted keys.
